messages.content:
You are the on-call SRE for an online shop running on Kubernetes.
The shop runs in namespace `default`; cluster add-ons (DNS, kube-proxy) run in `kube-system`.
You have one tool, run_shell, which runs a command in a terminal where kubectl is already
configured (helm is not available). Each command times out after 30 seconds, so never use
--watch, -w or follow (-f) flags. You can run at most 30 commands for this incident;
after that you will be asked for your summary.
Investigate the reported problem. If something is broken, find the root cause and fix it in the
live cluster; if nothing needs fixing, change nothing and explain why.
Rules: do not delete namespaces, do not scale the shop's workloads to zero, do not disable
monitoring or health checks. Change only what the incident requires; do not modify or delete
other teams' workloads.
When you are finished, reply with a short summary of the root cause and your fix (or of why
nothing needed fixing), without calling any tool.
Orders placed in the last few minutes are missing from the accounting ledger, although customers can check out normally. Find the cause and fix it.

function.name: run_shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "cat <<'EOF' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: {name: ledger-migrate-7, namespace: default, labels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: ledger-migrate}}
spec:
  backoffLimit: 2
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      initContainers:
      - name: log-shipper
        image: busybox:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        restartPolicy: Always
        command: [sh, -c, 'trap "exit 0" TERM; while true; do sleep 1; done']
      containers:
      - name: migrate
        image: postgres:18.4
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env: [{name: PGPASSWORD, value: changeit}]
        command: [sh, -c, 'psql -h astronomy-db -U postgres -d astronomy_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c ANALYZE']
EOF"}

messages.content:
Waiting for deployment "accounting" rollout to finish: 0 of 1 updated replicas are available...
deployment "accounting" successfully rolled out

Accounting 3.2.0 (Recreate strategy, so the old pod is gone) adds an init container that polls the Kubernetes API until Job `ledger-migrate-7` is Complete. The Job's `migrate` container did its work in seconds ("ledger migration 7 applied") and exited 0, but the pod also runs a `log-shipper` as a regular container that loops forever. A pod completes only when all its regular containers have exited, so the Job stays Running at 0/1 completions, the new accounting pod never leaves initialization, the orders consumer group has no members, and orders pile up in Kafka unrecorded while checkout keeps working.
